plugins.name: image-generator
plugins.description: Generate and edit images using Gemini's Nano Banana Pro model with text-to-image, editing, and multi-image composition

plugins.name: llm-council
plugins.description: Orchestrate multiple open-weight LLMs via Fireworks AI to deliberate on queries using Karpathy's LLM Council concept — models respond, rank each other, and a Chairman synthesizes the final answer

plugins.name: survey-generator
plugins.description: Generate polished, single-file HTML survey papers on any AI/ML topic. The agent curates a research bundle from a public anchor resource and Kimi K2.6 on Fireworks AI writes the academic artifact with inline SVG figures, numbered sections, and a References list in one call.
